items.title: Return signed tenancy contract
items.quote: Den unterschriebenen Vertrag benötigen wir innerhalb von 14 Werktagen ab dem Briefdatum zurück.
items.computation: Letter is dated Wed 18.11.2026 ('ab dem Briefdatum'). This is a cooperative/company letter, not an authority, so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies; the period runs explicitly from the printed letter date itself. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (18.11.2026) is not counted, so counting starts 19.11.2026. The letter defines Werktage as Monday to Saturday, excluding Sundays and public holidays. Counting 14 such Werktage from 19.11.2026 forward (skipping Sundays 22.11. and 29.11., no NW public holidays fall in this window) lands on Friday 04.12.2026. That day is itself a working day, so under § 193 BGB no further shift is needed. Final due date: 04.12.2026 (confirmed by the deadline tool).
